title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Four Typical Cases of Fundraising Fraud Crimes
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court Releases Four Typical Cases of Fundraising Fraud Crimes

In recent years, with the continuous development of China's economy and society, some criminals have exploited people's desire to get rich quickly in the short term by illegally raising funds to defraud money. This not only causes significant losses to people's property but also seriously disrupts financial order and affects social harmony and stability. To maintain the financial management order and deter lawless criminals, the Supreme People's Court recently released four typical cases of fundraising fraud crimes:

1. Defendant Tang Ya'nan Fundraising Fraud Case

The Bozhou Intermediate People's Court of Anhui Province found through trial: Defendant Tang Ya'nan, formerly the chairman and legal representative of Anhui Wanwuchun Technology Development Co., Ltd., had been sentenced to sixteen years' imprisonment in 1989 for fraud and escape, and was paroled in 1999. From June 2004 to March 2007, Tang Ya'nan, conspiring with others, using high returns as bait, exaggerated and falsely advertised the operating conditions of Wanwuchun Company's sika deer farming, and in the name of the company, signed "Joint Planting and Breeding Contracts" with 49,786 persons (times) across 116 counties and districts in seven provinces and municipalities including Anhui, Henan, Hebei, Shandong, Jiangxi, Jiangsu, and Beijing, illegally raising funds of over RMB 973 million. The vast majority of the proceeds were used by Tang Ya'nan and others for personal car purchases, real estate acquisitions, squandering, transferring and concealing, as well as paying principal and interest of previous fundraising, issuing high fundraising business rewards and business commissions. By the time the case was discovered, over RMB 333 million of the raised funds could not be repaid, and one victim committed suicide.

The Bozhou Intermediate People's Court sentenced Defendant Tang Ya'nan to death for the crime of fundraising fraud, deprived him of political rights for life, and confiscated all his personal property. After the judgment, Tang Ya'nan refused to accept and appealed. The Anhui High People's Court, after trial, lawfully rejected Tang Ya'nan's appeal, upheld the original judgment, and reported to the Supreme People's Court for approval according to law. The Supreme People's Court after review held that Defendant Tang Ya'nan, with the intent of illegal possession, conspired with others to defraud others of money by fabricating the purpose of funds and concealing the company's loss situation. His conduct constituted the crime of fundraising fraud, and the amount of fraud was especially huge, causing especially great losses to the people's interests. Tang Ya'nan planned and directed the fundraising fraud activities, was the principal offender, and was a recidivist. The circumstances of the crime were particularly heinous, and the crime was extremely serious. He should be severely punished according to law. Therefore, the Supreme People's Court lawfully approved the criminal ruling of the Anhui High People's Court that affirmed the first instance judgment sentencing Defendant Tang Ya'nan to death for the crime of fundraising fraud, deprivation of political rights for life, and confiscation of all personal property.

2. Defendant Sun Xiaoming Fundraising Fraud Case

The Hangzhou Intermediate People's Court of Zhejiang Province found through trial: Between December 2006 and November 2007, Defendant Sun Xiaoming, using the lure of high interest rates, on the pretext that Hangzhou Zhijiang Resort Faming Shouji Hang and Hangzhou Changrong Investment Management Co., Ltd., Zhuantang Branch needed funds, and fabricating facts such as needing funds to invest in television drama production, defrauded 28 victims including Liu Dalong of a total of RMB 14.66 million in raised funds in Hangzhou. Except for a small portion used to pay interest on the raised funds, most of the proceeds were used by Sun Xiaoming for gambling, debt repayment, usury lending, and squandering. By the time the case was discovered, over RMB 12.99 million of the raised funds could not be repaid.

The Hangzhou Intermediate People's Court sentenced Defendant Sun Xiaoming to death with a two-year reprieve for the crime of fundraising fraud, deprived him of political rights for life, and confiscated all his personal property. After the judgment, Sun Xiaoming accepted the sentence and did not appeal. The Zhejiang High People's Court after review lawfully approved the above judgment against Sun Xiaoming.

3. Defendant Lyu Weiqiang Fundraising Fraud Case

The Lishui Intermediate People's Court of Zhejiang Province found through trial: From August 2004 to March 2008, Defendant Lyu Weiqiang, using the lure of high interest rates, fabricated purposes for funds such as project bidding, doing foreign trade business with others, and investment funds, and adopted methods such as issuing IOUs and signing loan agreements to illegally raise funds of over RMB 260 million in Liandu District, Jinyun County, Qingtian County and other places in Lishui City, Zhejiang Province. Except for funds used to repay previous fundraising principal and pay high interest, the remaining portion was used by Lyu Weiqiang for personal squandering such as gambling in Macau, purchasing real estate, and cars. By the time the case was discovered, over RMB 40.38 million of the raised funds could not be repaid. On April 24, 2008, Defendant Lyu Weiqiang surrendered to the public security organ.

The Lishui Intermediate People's Court sentenced Defendant Lyu Weiqiang to death with a two-year reprieve for the crime of fundraising fraud, deprived him of political rights for life, and confiscated all his personal property. After the judgment, Lyu Weiqiang refused to accept and appealed. The Zhejiang High People's Court after trial lawfully rejected Lyu Weiqiang's appeal and upheld the original judgment.

4. Defendant Zhang Yuanlei Fundraising Fraud Case

The Guangzhou Intermediate People's Court of Guangdong Province found through trial: Between July 1997 and July 2007, Defendant Zhang Yuanlei, using his status as an insurance agent of China Life Insurance Co., Ltd., Guangzhou Branch, with the lure of repayment of principal at maturity and high monthly returns, fabricated insurance types, privately forged company seals to produce fake insurance policies, and deceived multiple victims including Hu Weidong into purchasing insurance, collecting "insurance premiums" totaling over RMB 21.25 million from the above persons. Except for the portion used to pay high interest due to the victims, the remaining funds were used for personal squandering. By the time the case was discovered, over RMB 4.88 million of the raised funds could not be repaid.

The Guangzhou Intermediate People's Court sentenced Defendant Zhang Yuanlei to twelve years' fixed-term imprisonment for the crime of fundraising fraud and imposed a fine of RMB 100,000. After the judgment, Zhang Yuanlei refused to accept and appealed. The Guangdong High People's Court after trial lawfully rejected Zhang Yuanlei's appeal and upheld the original judgment.
